mapper.sql: select cs.id, cs.subject_id, cs.teacher_id, cs.classroom_id, cs.class_date, cs.start_time, cs.end_time, cs.status, cs.remark, s.subject_name, t.teacher_name, c.classroom_name from edu_course_schedule cs left join edu_subject s on cs.subject_id = s.id left join edu_teacher t on cs.teacher_id = t.id left join edu_classroom c on cs.classroom_id = c.id
mapper.insert: insert into edu_course_schedule (subject_id, teacher_id, classroom_id, class_date, start_time, end_time, status, remark, create_time) values(#{subjectId}, #{teacherId}, #{classroomId}, #{classDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{remark}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update edu_course_schedule set subject_id = #{subjectId}, teacher_id = #{teacherId}, classroom_id = #{classroomId}, class_date = #{classDate}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
